lines.a: 絕望中 祢仍然不停地運行
lines.b: When I'm in despair, I know You are working
You pulled me out of the darkest place

lines.a: 不停追尋我 直到我得自由
lines.b: And You chased my heart, until You set me free

lines.a: 祢是我曠野中唯一的力量
lines.b: Oh Father, You're my strength in the wilderness

lines.a: 患難中的安慰 黑暗中的盼望
lines.b: Light in the darkness, and a lamp unto my feet

lines.a: 我呼求的日子 祢必拯救我
lines.b: When I cry out to You, You will rescue me

lines.a: 信實的天父 我依靠祢
lines.b: Faithful Father, I will trust in You

lines.a: 阿爸父 我是尊貴的兒女
lines.b: Abba, You call me a child of God

lines.a: 祢教我如何用權柄爭戰
lines.b: You taught me, how to fight with authority

lines.a: 阿爸父 祢用笑臉幫助我
lines.b: Abba, You are smiling upon me
No longer cursed, I'm Your blessed child

lines.a: 我呼求的日子 祢必拯救我
lines.b: When I cry out to You, You will rescue me

lines.a: 信實的天父 我依靠祢
lines.b: Faithful Father, I will trust in You
